name.zh-TW: 文心森林公園／圓滿戶外劇場

identity: The white modern outdoor stage and fan-shaped audience bowl inside Wenxin Forest Park, not National Taichung Theater.

officialPages.publisher: Fulfillment Amphitheatre, Taichung Cultural Affairs Bureau
officialPages.evidence: Official site describes the stage/roof and park relationship; page links the aerial photo.
Page56, Fulfillment Amphitheater:official indexed visual/text evidence calls out the white ribbon-like roof and grassy tiered seating; PDF retrieval timed out, so this is corroboration only.

officialPhotos.publisher: Fulfillment Amphitheatre, Taichung Cultural Affairs Bureau
officialPhotos.visualInspection: Direct official aerial photo inspected in own Chrome tab. Layered white curved canopy strips with dark elongated gaps cover an open black stage; concentric fan-shaped brown seating terraces and green lawns wrap around it.

distinguishingMotifs: Low, broad white canopy made of layered curling shell/ribbon surfaces, with elongated dark slots between them.
A dark open stage mouth underneath the projecting white roof; no enclosed front facade.
Semicircular/fan-shaped tiered audience seating wraps around the stage in nested curved bands.
Warm brown seating/steps alternate with green lawn and pale curved paths.
The amphitheater sits in a broad planted urban park; trees and a few slim light poles support the composition.
materialColors: Bright ivory/white canopy with cool gray shadows
Green lawn and pale gray paths
pixelPriorities: Keep the white folded canopy and curved seating as the two strongest readable shapes.
Let the terraces establish the overhead park footprint without drawing every bench.
avoid: Temple-shaped park, pagoda, castle or fountain hero
Closed civic building with rows of windows
Simple spherical dome instead of the layered open canopy
Confusing this venue with ToyoIto National Taichung Theater
rights: Reference links only. Do not copy source photographs into shipped game art. Draw original pixel interpretations.
